How we work

A better experience is built into the process.

Every phase has a purpose, an owner and a clear next decision.

  1. 01

    Listen + Define

    We clarify your goals, site, scope, priorities and practical constraints.

  2. 02

    Plan + Align

    Design, budget, permits, procurement and schedule become one coordinated roadmap.

  3. 03

    Build + Communicate

    Site work moves forward with regular updates, documented decisions and quality reviews.

  4. 04

    Finish + Handover

    We close out details carefully and help you understand the completed space.

Straight answers

Planning your next project?

Start with the questions clients ask us most.

What construction services does VR Plus provide?

VR Plus Construction provides custom home building, residential renovation, commercial construction, condo renovation, pre-construction and construction management across Metro Vancouver.

Where does VR Plus Construction work?

The team serves Vancouver, West Vancouver, North Vancouver, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Richmond, Surrey, Delta and surrounding Metro Vancouver communities.

Can VR Plus help before construction starts?

Yes. Pre-construction support can include scope review, design coordination, budgeting, schedule planning, constructability and permit coordination.

How do I request a construction quote?

Call (778) 318-6796, email admin@vrplusconstruction.com, or use the project inquiry form to share your location, scope and preferred timing.
